search_queries.name: agent_tools
search_queries.query: ("Claude Code" OR "Grok Build" OR Codex OR Cursor OR GrokBot OR "Grok Bot") (subagents OR worktrees OR "agent team" OR swarm OR built OR automated OR "set up") has:videos -is:retweet -is:reply lang:en min_likes:50
search_queries.worked: matig: min_likes lijkt niet streng te filteren; veel trading-bait

notes: Operators: min_likes:/min_reposts: (niet min_faves:), has:videos, lang:en; start_time ISO in UTC (laatste 7 dagen).
In deze run leverde min_likes ook posts met 0 likes op; filter likes zelf na, maar niet alleen op likes.
Uitsluiten: tekst met 'comment "', "I'll DM", 'Save this', '$X → $Y'/'overnight' trading, 'This AI animation is literally a masterpiece', 'HOLY'/'f*cking crazy' templates, 'reportedly/allegedly'.
